entities.summary: Henrik Eriksson is a professional Swedish ice hockey player. As of 2014–2015 he is a right winger for Djurgårdens IF Hockey in HockeyAllsvenskan. Eriksson previously played for Mora IK in HockeyAllsvenskan. Eriksson played in Djurgården junior teams before making his debut in the senior team.
